paras: Application: Subaru WRX VB (2022+) Part Type: PCV-side oil catch can kit (Fluid Lock) Part Number: 20-0754-FL

A Radium catch can draws oil and water condensation out of the crankcase gases before they reach the intake, helping keep the intake tract, intercooler, throttle body and intake manifold clean and keeping oil vapour out of the cabin. Radium's patented Fluid Lock design, introduced in 2022, stops the reservoir from overfilling and holds collected fluid until the can is emptied, so it can't be drawn back into the intake.
hl: Fluid Lock: Patented design prevents overfilling and traps collected fluid until emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Easy Draining: 4AN ORB drain port; optional petcock drain kit available
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
ft: Radium Engineering PCV Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit for Subaru WRX VB 2022+
